headline: Sanctioned Oil Tankers Pivot to Persian Gulf Routes
summary: Tankers previously used to ship crude oil from sanctioned nations like Venezuela are now deploying to transport crude out of the Middle East.
why: Shifts in global tanker deployment patterns affect spot freight rates and logistics capacity across international crude shipping routes.

impacts.name: Oil Shipping
impacts.why: Redistribution of crude tankers to Middle Eastern export routes alters regional freight availability and shipping economics.
